verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `\prod_{i\ {\rm seed}}a_i\le e^{-\kappa'_B\beta t^2|A|}`.
evidence: [M] prints ∏a_i ≤ e^{−κ′βt²|A|} and ∫g_A dν ≤ P(x)(1+s_A)^d e^{−κ′βt²|A|}∏f_i (B-section.tex:905-919). `Invoices.vapors` (E6/Issue.lean:72-86) bounds packets by exp((C·bill⁵ − β·μ·fiery²)·shares) (credit at Grants.lean:48, income at Charge.lean:22), with an extra growing factor and no κ′. `Sector.peel` (Next/FLUCTUATIONS/Sector.lean:229) gives only a relative bound prefactor·e^{−βκ·fiery²·shares}, and the molecule majorant `Herd.nil` (Daisy/Charm.lean:48) has no seed suppression, so neither bound is stated as printed.

`Invoices.vapors` (CONNECTED_ACTIVITY_JETS_E6/Issue.lean:78-88) bounds packets by `income 1 (C·bill⁵) gain shares` = exp((C·bill⁵ − β μ fiery²)·shares) (Push/ABSOLUTE_SUMS/Charge.lean:22, Grants.lean:48). No lemma absorbs C·bill⁵ into the fiery² credit: `bill_pays` (Delay.lean:120) compares with `hatWin`, which uses fineMonitor. So e^{−κ′βt²|A|} and the A_c ≠ ∅ value majorant are not stated. The warning bound E^r has an abstract E, charged through `Sales` against `goal` = β^{rate}, a normalization of ε_w^{2r} that the claim does not mention.
